contea di ritrovamento: Cumbria (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ ANTONINVS PIVS AVG BRIT ; R/ PROVIDENTIAE DEORVM

Denarius of Caracalla dating from AD212-213. Obverse description: laureate head right. Obverse inscription: ANTONINVS PIVS AVG BRIT. Reverse description: Providentia standing facing left, with upright sceptre, pointing baton at globe at her feet. Reverse inscription: PROVIDENTIAE DEORVM. Mint: Rome. Ref: RIC IV (Caracalla) 227
